method: Frozen-source-guarded JavaScript reference of static/dynamic body clearance and swept-bounds/candidate/old shortcut sampling. No WGSL execution, pathfinding fallback, earned rescues, browser, GPU timing or performance claim.

checks.name: doorway lip: a clear center line is rejected when the body overlaps the jamb
short final segment: a blocked endpoint is checked even below the old 0.5 m interval
upper body: a voxel above the center-ray height still blocks the follower
dynamic wreckage: ground-level occupancy blocks a shortcut through otherwise empty voxels
overhead wreckage: occupancy outside the body height does not close the route
removed wall and cleared wreckage: the same route reopens without stale blockage
open doorway remains open while a center-clear narrow slit is rejected
world border rejects a body extending outside even when its center remains inside
zero-distance open goal is safe and the 20 m shortcut cutoff stays intact
